train_support.name: Train central-95% support proxy
train_support.sample_rule: ALL executed Train commands including terminal unpaired commands; no Val/Test/benchmark/holdout
train_support.caveat: per-dimension central95% box; NOT complete in-distribution manifold or strict OOD boundary

noise_normalization.rule: central per-axis2.5..97.5 percentiles; last unpaired episode command excluded

hardware.inference: 512 candidates batched; inference_mode; terminal decode only; incremental1-step GRU realhistory
hardware.timing_scope: planning includes sampling,T recursion,terminal decoding,cost,argmin/transfer; separate totaldecision includes causal encoder; excludes simulator stepping, disk writes, plotting; no sleep to enforce realtime

execution_hardware.inference: 512 candidates batched; inference_mode; terminal decode only; incremental1-step GRU realhistory
execution_hardware.timing_scope: planning includes sampling,T recursion,terminal decoding,cost,argmin/transfer; separate totaldecision includes causal encoder; excludes simulator stepping, disk writes, plotting; no sleep to enforce realtime

configuration.sampling: original recursive random walk; env clipping first; Supported additionally clips to fixed central95% Train box before next increment; anchors projected too
configuration.cost: J=||error_xyz_H||^2 +0.5||velocity_xyz_H||^2 +0.1*yaw_error_H^2 +0.05*mean_k||normalized a[k]-a[k-1]||^2; a[-1]=previous executed; hand-designed NOT RL reward
configuration.replanning: incremental true-history encoder with previous executed normalized action; pureT recursion; execute first action only
configuration.pairing: original SeedSequence([0,split_index,episode_index]) episode seed; identical generator and one510x10x4draw everydecision; SHA256 actual scaled epsilon verifies matching decision index
configuration.projection_quantiles: fixed1e-4 histogram empirical-rank upper estimates, bounded error1e-4; exact mean/counts; no raw candidate arrays saved
configuration.prediction_window_rule: first3 fixed episodes/split regardless of outcome; legal10step starts stride25; actions actually executed after replanning

analysis.completion_time_caveat: Supported has no successes: completion time N/A. Unconstrained 1.24s comes from only one success, not a usable-controller speed estimate.
analysis.mechanical_metric_caveat: Zero box departure validates projection. Zero |a|>=0.95 saturation follows mechanically from all support bounds below0.95, not successful braking.
analysis.prediction_validity: Mixed, not consistently improved. All legal first3episode windows: benchmark H10 falls but H1 worsens; holdout H1/H10 worsen. Common-available identities: benchmark worsens at both horizons, holdout improves at both. States/actions differ; ordinary yaw wrap and survival/window composition limit attribution.
analysis.candidate_collapse: 56.2-56.6% candidate timesteps project, 19.0-19.3% candidate elements at a support boundary; 32.5-33.7% selected elements at boundary. Mean unique first-action fraction remains99.4%: boundary pileup, no global candidate-set collapse demonstrated.
analysis.causal_scope: Hard support projection has measured effects on command magnitude and physical failure mix, but no task-success improvement. This does not strengthen the claim that marginal action-support departure/model exploitation is the sufficient or unique failure cause, nor rule out state/action-sequence OOD.
analysis.remaining_mechanism: Prediction and decision fidelity remain inadequate under planner-induced visitation even with all selected actions inside the coarse box. State/action-sequence distribution shift, cost ranking fidelity and fixed short horizon remain unseparated.
analysis.next_only_recommendation: Offline action-sequence ranking / decision-cost fidelity benchmark: same frozen model and cost, compare predicted versus actual simulated costs under identical executed sequences. Do not perform it here or tune planner parameters.
